releases.name: Typo Royale
releases.summary: Think you're a fast typer? What if you couldn't see the words you need to type? Typo Royale is a competitive speed typing and spelling game where phrases are read aloud by an announcer. To secure a win, you'll need to both spell the phrase correctly and submit it faster than your opponents.

releases.name: Nav Singh's Stranded
releases.summary: Stranded is a 4-12 player horror survival game where you and your friends are survivors stranded on a cursed island. An evil entity known as the "dark stalker" approaches players, offering them life in exchange for killing another survivor.

releases.name: SHOCKFACE
releases.summary: A survival horror game where you explore a hostile building, solve item-based puzzles, hide from a stalking killer, and use sound, memory, and route knowledge to survive.

releases.name: Monster Collector
releases.summary: Collect over 1,000 monsters, including rare variants and ultra-rare creatures. Explore 20 regions, complete every collection, and become the ultimate collector in this collection-focused monster RPG.

releases.name: Our Echoes
releases.summary: 君は未来をどう思う？ 希望に満ちた可能性？ それとも憂鬱な予定？ この世界は「未来」が少しだけ壊れている。1999年、朱く染まる空の下、記憶を失った主人公は終末の真実を追う。短編サイコロジカル・ビジュアルノベル。

releases.name: Paper Trail (Meridian Studios)
releases.summary: Fold, launch, and glide across an ever-expanding classroom. Earn coins to upgrade your paper plane, chase distance records, ride thermals and dodge storms. Unlock planes, trails, and a secret shop — then start New Game+. Just one more throw!

releases.name: Orb Breaker
releases.summary: A short incremental bullet hell game about shooting ricocheting orbs at enemies, collecting resources, and becoming over powered.

releases.name: The Day of Revenge
releases.summary: The story takes place in a fictional world of sword and sorcery. The protagonist, Amelia, hails from a family of mages but was cast out due to her utter lack of magical aptitude; forced to move into a haunted house, she encounters the ghost of the home's former owner—and so the story begins.

releases.name: Orbital Checkpoint
releases.summary: Orbital Checkpoint is a sci-fi border control simulator. Check alien documents, scan suspicious luggage, detect contraband, and manage your tight budget on station GSA-42. Regulations change daily, but bills for oxygen and coffee always arrive on time. Will you risk letting the Acid Lemons pass?

releases.name: The Witch's Game:Wheel of Fortune
releases.summary: A turn-based strategy card game built on Texas Hold'em hand rankings. Answer the call to another world and duel eight witches with your soul points at stake. Manage your hand, time your spells, and outsmart your opponents in a blend of luck and strategy. Short rounds, pick up and play anytime.

releases.name: Minenumbing
releases.summary: MineNumbing is a hand-drawn tower defense game where players build powerful turrets using bombs and fight alongside them with a magical pencil. Combine strategy, resource management, and fast-paced combat to survive increasingly challenging enemy waves.

releases.name: Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?
releases.summary:
In "Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?" you have to escape from hundreds of interesting puzzle rooms. You will encounter laser beams, portals, pressure plates, and strange collectibles that will grant you and other objects new powers.

Gradually learn the mechanics and discover their surprising consequences across 150 hand-crafted puzzles. Each puzzle has a unique idea; there is no filler. By the end you will master the snake movement and discover what you are truly made of.

releases.name: Sylva's Blessing
releases.summary: TrivPals is the speedy battle of wits for trivia pals!Challenge a friend, then race against the clock in fun, fast duels to see who’s smarter. TrivPals lets you outwit your pals anywhere, anytime – and prove you’re trivia royalty among dunces.Features in TrivPals:? Speedy!Take turns answering as many questions as you can over three exhilarating one-minute rounds.? Smart!Thousands of questions in various categories designed to flex your brain.? Bonuses!Eliminate answers when you’re stumped, freeze time when you need a sec, score big when you catchfire.? Friends!Use Facebook to play all your pals, and find out who knows what.? Free!Play as many simultaneous games as you want, until your brain is full.??????????????Rate TrivPals in the App Store so we can make new features for you!??????????????Become a pal! Stay updated on TrivPals news and clues:Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/trivpals/Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/trivpals/Get free support: http://www.trivpals.com/feedback/Download and play today!

releases.name: The Black King
releases.summary: XOX is a Tic-Tac-Toe (naughts and crosses) game with high score ability.See how many games in a row you can win to become the XOX world champion.

releases.name: Mimic Party
releases.summary: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

releases.name: OK JELLY
releases.summary: A physics-based action puzzle game where you play with jiggling jellies underwater. Connect and clear many jellies of the same color to compete for a high score.

releases.name: Uploader
releases.summary: Uploader is a sci-fi psychological thriller visual novel. Wake up with no memory, investigate reality-bending anomalies, and uncover a corporation's darkest secret. Branching dialogue, multiple endings, and a retro terminal interface await. Trust nothing. Question everything.

releases.name: Aggelos 2
releases.summary:
Jump into an action-packed 2D retro Metroidvania adventure where reactive combat, smart exploration and powerful polarising abilities collide.

Aggelos 2 is a full evolution of the original, now thrusting the visuals into the 16-bit era. Its transformational twist takes the gameplay to another level, as the world now exists in two overlapping realms: Light and Darkness.

You are an Aggelos - the highest rank among the angels - as the gods face imminent defeat at the hands of the Army of Darkness, you are sent on an epic journey by Balro through Lumen, the domain of the supreme god of light. With Lumen under siege, you must battle through the chaos in both the Light and Dark worlds layered over one another. Both filled with challenging enemies, twisting paths, and thought-provoking puzzles. Shifting between realms is key to your survival and progress.

releases.name: Scott Pilgrim EX: Back in the Band
releases.summary: A night at a Gangnam dance club in the most posh neighborhood of South Korea is always a good time. It's even better when you're Gangnam robot is wearing a jet pack flying high over the dance floor.  As you fly to your favorite K-Pop single watch out for competitors and overcome them with your notes and with your singing as well.  ---------------- Here's how the game works: Gameplay is simple and becomes more challenging as you avoid obstacles: - Slide your thumb or a finger on your Gangnam Guy at the left of the screen to move forward, back, up and down. - Grab gold and platinum records to unlock more characters with a variety of outfits and avoid oncoming challengers- The longer you play, the faster the game moves. Each time you play Gangnam Jetpack Fighter, it changes so you never play the same game twice - Gamecenter Leaderboards let you see how you score compared to other players by how long you're able to survive and collect platinum and gold records- Challenge your friends to beat your score! ----------------

releases.name: Lou's Lagoon
releases.summary:
Launch from the sea and take to the skies! Lou's Lagoon is a cosy open world adventure where you make friends and uncover secrets across a gorgeous archipelago.

Collect, harvest, fish, craft and trade various goods, then deliver them safely to the individual islands in your trusty seaplane. Customise and strengthen your plane over time, overcoming storms, pirates, and magic in order to reach new islanders. Forge new connections and service your community.

Secrets lurk in the corners of every island. While completing deliveries, you'll also unearth treasures and find clues about your wacky uncle Lou.

releases.name: Model Debut4
releases.summary:
You passed a modeling audition and joined your uncle's production company. It turns out to be a rundown office that's struggling financially!

Determined to turn the production company around, you take on a variety of roles, including magazine modeling, TV appearances, and brand image modeling! Plus, produce the two models who belong to the company to boost the production!

And what awaits you there is the once-a-year special runway show, the "Nicola Show"! 

Aim for the "Top of Nicola" title, the No. 1 model everyone dreams of!. Fashion, work, and exciting encounters await you...

releases.name: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
releases.summary:
In 1964, Naked Snake, who saved the world from the threat of all-out nuclear war between the United States and the Soviet Union, was hailed as a true hero and bestowed the title "BIGBOSS." However, after the award ceremony, Snake disappeared...

Ten years later, Snake, who had organized his own army in Colombia, South America, is visited by a visitor from Costa Rica, a country without an army.

Costa Rica, a region of Latin America that holds the key to the East-West power balance since the Cuban Missile Crisis, has miraculously maintained peace. However, mysterious armed groups have been making suspicious moves across the country. 

They ask Snake to investigate and eliminate the group. 

Snake hesitates to accept the request, but the tape they bring contains the voice of The Boss, who was supposed to be dead.

releases.name: The Immortal John Triptych
releases.summary:
Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide. 

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy. 

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.
